reference: There is no matching GNU/POSIX NTP CLI in the source build; the status catalog lists chronyc/ntpd as missing. The runnable contract cases use Bash's documented type -t and help builtins and check the registered ntp_doc surface from the pinned source. Protocol behavior is deferred instead of being represented as GNU parity or inferred from candidate output.
coverage: Executed coverage is Bash availability/help metadata only; no operational behavior is counted as a pass.
Bash reports ntp as a builtin through type -t.
Bash help exposes the documented query, sync, run and serve synopsis and selected safety/configuration contracts.
exclusions: No parity case is claimed because the loadable has no matching GNU/POSIX command-line implementation.
No network operation is executed in this suite, including loopback traffic.
No clock-setting or clock-discipline operation is executed.
No NTS self-test is run because its success marker is not part of the documented help contract and its internal verifier is not an independent oracle.
Refclock device, physical timing, kernel discipline and live time-server behavior require later disposable VM or syscall-mock qualification.

cases.purpose: Confirm Bash classifies the loadable command as a builtin, using the documented type -t contract without invoking an NTP operation.
Check Bash help metadata contains the documented subcommand synopsis, dry-run promise and config keys without opening sockets or changing time.
cases.script:
doc=$(help ntp)
[[ $doc == *"ntp query SERVER [-t MS] [-p PORT]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"ntp sync [-s SERVER]... [-t MS] [-n] [-l LIMIT] [-P POLLS]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"ntp run [-d STATEDIR] [-i SECS] [-c CONFIG] [--once]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"ntp serve [-S ADDR[:PORT]] [--stratum N] [--refid STR]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"--dry-run-discipline prints the would-apply action and mutates no clock."* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"Config keys: server <host|nts:host>, interval <sec>, retry <sec>,"* ]] || exit 1
printf '%s\n' 'ntp documented help surface present'

cases.purpose: Exercise query request/reply matching and the normal, alarm, KoD, malformed-response and timeout paths.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM with a private network namespace with a local UDP NTP peer that emits fixed RFC 5905 packets from an independent packet builder. The peer must check the request originate timestamp and provide normal stratum, LI alarm, RATE KoD, malformed mode/timestamp and no-response scenarios. This suite performs no network activity.

cases.purpose: Verify multi-server offset aggregation, panic/clamp boundaries and the documented -n applied=no result.
cases.reason: Requires local deterministic UDP NTP peers in a future disposable VM with a private network namespace plus a syscall mock/recorder for clock_settime, adjtime and adjtimex. The future fixture should assert median and boundary results and prove -n makes no clock syscall; any mutating sync path must remain behind the mock. This suite performs no network or clock operation.

cases.purpose: Check a serve response's mode/version/leap/stratum/refid and timestamp fields against a fixed client request.
cases.reason: Requires a local client/server packet exchange inside a future disposable VM with a private network namespace and an independent RFC 5905 response decoder. The fixture should use an unprivileged high port and deterministic request fields; it must not use an external peer or hardware refclock. This suite performs no network activity.

cases.purpose: Check config parsing, cfg/last state records, one-shot completion and the documented dry-run discipline output.
cases.reason: Requires a private relative config/state fixture, a local deterministic UDP peer in a future disposable VM with a private network namespace, and a syscall mock that records/rejects clock_settime, adjtime and adjtimex. The future case should compare resulting files and assert dry-run reports live_clock_settime=no and live_ntp_adjtime=no. This suite performs no network or clock operation.

cases.purpose: Verify the NTS-KE negotiation, cookie handling and authenticated NTP response path against independently generated protocol fixtures.
cases.reason: Requires local TLS NTS-KE and UDP NTP mock peers in a future disposable VM with a private network namespace, with test-only certificates/keys and an independent RFC 8915 plus AES-SIV-CMAC fixture generator/verifier. No installed credentials or external server may be used. This suite performs no network activity.
